Overall Note for disclosure under SEBI 1.As Listed banks are not be required to provide the disclosures with respect to related party transactions involving loans, inter-corporate deposits, advances or investments made or given by the listed banks, no disclosure for the same has been made. 2.In terms of para 5 of AS-18, transactions in the nature of banker customer relationship have not been disclosed. 3.In terms of para 9 of AS-18, disclosure is not given in respect of transaction with related parties which are "State Controlled Entities" 4.The remuneration and sitting fees paid by the listed entity or its subsidiary to its director, KMP or senior management, except who is part of promoter or promoter group, shall not require disclosure provided the same is not material as per Regulaion 23(9) 5.The above transactions are exempted/pre-approved/under omnibus approval of ACB as per bank's Policy on Related Party transactions.
* Represents Notional Value of Derivative contracts and Forex Swap/Spot transactions.
